searchText: I'm a bit late to the party, but is there any reason to keep the old blocks currently, and not just the headers? You need them to reproduce the state "from scratch" but you can get the state from other nodes and check it against the state root. *someone* has to store it if you're a light client then it's safe to throw away if you want to verify proofs about historical transactions and state you need to keep the roots (and maybe blooms can help) at the very least
